simple.summary: שָׂטָה (sâṭâh) means to deviate from duty First listed occurrence: Num 5 12.

definitions.full: H7847. satah [ שָׂטָה ] verb turn aside (Aramaic סְטָא , id. ; שְׂטָא stray ; Ethiopic III. be seduced , etc.; cf Dr JPhil. xi (1882), 205 ); — Qal Perfect 2feminine singular שָׂטִית Num 5:19-20 , Imperfect 3feminine singular תִּשְׂטֶה 5:12 ; 5:29 , jussive 3masculine singular יֵשְׂטְ Prov 7:25 ; Imperative masculine singular שְׂטֵה 4:15 ; — turn aside , of unfaithful wife Num 5:12 (absolute), + אִישׁ תַּחַת , i.e. while married, 5:19 (+ טֻמְאָה adverb accusative), 5:20 ; 5:29 (all P); of youth, from ( מֵעַל ) way of evil woman Prov 4:15 , toward ( אֶל ) her ways 7:25 .
